body: Founder: ensure we have controller mappings for all games. Same pattern as WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS/shankpit-460: SDL_GameController, hot-plug, keyboard fallback, real pressure-sensitive fire off real trigger travel, dual-stick move/look, A/B/X/Y/RB mapped to jump/crouch/reload/use/ability (reload suppressed while in a helicopter, matching the existing keyboard convention). gcc clean, smoke-tested live under Xvfb (clean launch, no crash).
title: Real Xbox controller support
